This record covers single maps of the island of Maui, Hawaii, which are not represented in the LC database by separate catalog records. This collection includes single printed maps and photocopies of single maps and may also include some multi-sheet single maps, plates from atlases, books or periodicals, and printed facsimiles. These maps also show various subjects including coasts, parks and reserves, roads, and recreation and tourism. To request a specific map or for more information, contact a reference librarian in the Geography & Map Division (202) 707-6277 or through the "Ask a librarian" link through the Geography & Map Division website https://ask.loc.gov/map-geography/.
